en: At the very beginning of the tea-picking season, Azumi's son died.
u.src: 采茶时节刚开始的时候，阿住的儿子去世了。

en: Her son Jintaro was almost paralyzed, and had been bedridden with illness for more than eight years.
u.src: 儿子仁太郎跟瘫痪了差不多，已经因病卧床八年有余。

ja: しみだけではなかった。
en: For Azumi, who was said to be earning merit for the next life, the loss of such a son brought more than grief.
u.src: 这样一个儿子的离去，对于被称作“来世积德”的阿住而言，她心中不仅仅有哀伤。

en: As she held a stick of incense in her hand before her son's coffin, she also felt the relief of having laid down a burden.
u.src: 当她手里举着一炷香，在儿子的棺材前面的时候，心中还有一种放下负担的解脱感。

en: After Nintaro's funeral was over, the first matter they had to face was whether his wife Tami should stay or leave.
u.src: 处理完仁太郎的丧事后，第一件要面对的事儿就是儿媳妇阿民的去留。

en: Tami had borne a son, and while Nintaro lay ill in bed she did all the farm work in her husband's place.
u.src: 阿民生了一个儿子，在仁太郎卧病在床期间，她替丈夫做了所有的农务。

en: If they made her leave now, looking after the child would of course be no problem, but the farm work at home would become impossible to sustain.
u.src: 倘若现在让她离开，照顾孩子自然不成问题，但是家里的农务就难以支撑了。

en: So Asumi planned to wait until the forty-nine days of mourning had passed, then bring in a husband for Tami and have her carry the household burden just as she had when her son was alive.
u.src: 因此，阿住计划等七七四十九天之后，帮阿民招赘一个丈夫，如儿子还在世的时候一样，由她负责家里的负担。

en: Asumi had already found a candidate to marry into the family: Nintaro's cousin Yokichi.
u.src: 阿住已经物色好了一个招赘的人选——仁太郎的表弟与吉。

en: Therefore, on the morning after the first seven days of mourning had ended, one can imagine how frightened Osumi was when she saw Otami putting clothes in order.
u.src: 因此，在头七结束的第二天早上，阿住看见阿民在整理衣服的时候，心里的惊吓可想而知。

en: At that time, Osumi was playing with her grandson Hiroji in the corridor of the inner room.
u.src: 当时，阿住正带着孙子广次在里屋的廊下玩耍。

en: Osumi had secretly picked a single cherry blossom from the school and given it to her grandson to play with.
u.src: 阿住从学校偷偷摘了一朵樱花给孙子玩。

en: Amin, there is something I have never had the courage to say to you; it was all my fault.
u.src: “阿民，我心里有句话一直没好意思跟你说，都是我的不好。

ja: ってしまったのですか
en: But how could you bear to leave your grandson behind and go away?
u.src: 但是你怎么忍心丢下孙子，走了呢？”

en: The tone in which Azhu spoke was less a scolding than a plea.
u.src: 阿住说话的语气，与其是说不是训斥，毋宁说是恳求。

en: But Amin did not even turn her head; she only laughed aloud:
u.src: 但是，阿民头也没回，只是笑出声来啊：

en: What on earth are you talking about, Granny?
u.src: “你究竟再说什么啊？婆婆！”

en: Those words were like giving Azhu a pill to steady her heart.
u.src: 这句话就像给阿住吃了一颗定心丸。

en: Yes, I thought you would not do that either.
u.src: “是啊，我想着你也不会那么做呢。”

en: Osumi began to lament without stopping.
u.src: 阿住开始不停地哀叹。

en: As she went on talking, Osumi herself was hurt by her own words and grew more and more sorrowful.
u.src: 说着说着，阿住自己也被自己讲的话触痛，越来越伤感。

en: At last, two streams of hot tears ran down Osumi's wrinkled face.
u.src: 最后，阿住满脸皱纹的脸上流下了两行热泪。

en: Yes! As long as Mother is willing, I would like to stay in this house for the rest of my life.
u.src: “是啊！只要婆婆愿意，我也想一辈子都在这个家里。

en: Besides, there is a child too; how could I bear to leave?
u.src: ——况且还有一个孩子呢，我怎么会舍得离开呢？”

en: As Amin went on talking, tears began to fall too, and she held her son Hirotsugu on her lap.
u.src: 阿民说着说着也流下了眼泪，把儿子广次抱在腿上。

en: Unexpectedly, Hirotsugu suddenly grew a little shy and could think only of the cherry blossoms on the old tatami mats in the room.
u.src: 没料到广次突然有些害羞，只惦记着房间内陈旧榻榻米上的樱花。

en: Amin's life was much the same as when her husband had been alive, and she still took on all the farm work.
u.src: 阿民的生活跟丈夫在世的时候没什么两样，依旧承担着所有的农务。

en: But the matter of taking in a husband by adoption did not go as smoothly as expected, mainly because Amin had no interest in it.
u.src: 不过，对于招赘丈夫的事情，却不如预想的顺利，主要是阿民对这件事不感兴趣。

en: Of course, whenever Aju had the chance, she would quietly sound out Amin's feelings, or ask her directly what she thought.
u.src: 当然了，阿住只要一有机会，就会不着痕迹的打探阿民的心意，或者直接询问她的想法。

en: But each time, Amin brushed it aside, saying, "I understand. Let us talk about it again next year!"
u.src: 不过，阿民每次都敷衍了事，“了解了，明年再说吧！”

en: Although Aju was somewhat worried by such an answer, she also felt a certain comfort in her heart.
u.src: 阿住对这样的回答虽然有些担心，但是内心还有某种安慰。

en: For one thing, Aju also cared about what people would think, so in the end she followed her daughter-in-law's wishes and decided to discuss it again next year.
u.src: 一方面，阿住也顾忌世间人情，总而言之最后还是依照儿媳妇的意思，明年再说吧。

en: But when the second year came, Amin still went out early and came home late, busy with farm work every day and unwilling to think about anything else.
u.src: 但是到了第二年，阿民依然早出晚归，天天忙着干农务，其他的事情都不愿意想。

en: Azhu urged Amin even more earnestly than the previous year to take a husband into the family, mainly because she was under pressure from her relatives' reproaches and the neighbors' gossip, leaving her with a bitterness she could not speak of.
u.src: 阿住比去年更加殷勤的劝说阿民招赘的事儿，主要是因为受到亲戚们的责备和邻居们的闲话影响，她有苦难言。

en: But, Amin... you are still young, and with no man by your side, how are you going to get by?
u.src: “但是啊……阿民，你还年轻，身边没有个男人，怎么过下去啊？”

ja: らしていくしかないよ。
en: Even if we cannot get by, we still have to go on living.
u.src: “过不下去也得过下去啊。
婆婆啊，你想想，

ja: はとてもかわいそうになる、
en: if you bring in an outsider as a son-in-law, Hirotsugu will be miserable,
u.src: 招赘个外人进来，广次会变得很可怜，

en: and you will have misgivings too,
u.src: 你也会心有顾虑，

en: so I will worry every bit as much, if not more.
u.src: 那我操的心有过之而无不及呢。”

ja: まさにそういうわけで、
en: That is exactly why I want you to take Yokichi as a son-in-law and keep him close by.
u.src: “正是因为这样，我才希望你把与吉招赘紧挨。

en: I hear he has recently given up gambling as well.
u.src: 据说他最近也已经戒赌了。”

en: Although he was my mother-in-law's relative, to me he was only an outsider.
u.src: “尽管他是婆婆的亲戚，但他对我来说只是个外人。

en: I thought that as long as I kept holding on...
u.src: 我觉得只要自己坚持下去……”

en: But keeping it up is not something that takes only one or two years.
u.src: “但是，坚持下去可不是一年两年的事情啊。”

en: Please do not talk about this anymore.
u.src: “请别再说这件事情了。
所有的一切都是为了阿广。

en: If I bear a little hardship by myself now, the family's farmland will not be split in two, and in the end it can be kept as it is and passed into A-Hiro's hands.
u.src: 现在我一个人辛苦一些，家里的农田就不会被分成两部分，最后就能保持现状传给阿广手里。”
“因此，阿民，

en: whenever Azhu spoke to this point, her voice would become grave and low
u.src: （每当说到这里的时候，阿住的声音都会变得严肃低沉）

en: no matter what, people are always frightening!
u.src: 无论如何，人总是可畏的啊！

en: try telling someone else what you just told me...
u.src: 你现在跟我说的话，可以跟别人说说看……”

en: No one knew how many times this kind of conversation had taken place between them.
u.src: 她们之间这种类似的对话，不知道曾经发生过多少次。

en: But Amin's resolve did not waver in the slightest; instead, it grew firmer and firmer.
u.src: 但是阿民的决心一点也没有动摇，反而越来越坚定。

en: In fact, Amin needed no help from men; she planted melons and reaped wheat all by herself, working even harder than before.
u.src: 事实上，阿民无需借助男人的帮助，一个人又是种瓜，又是割麦子，比以前更加卖力气。

en: Nor was that all: in summer she tended the cow, and even on rainy days she went out to the fields as usual to weed.
u.src: 不仅仅是这样，夏天饲养母牛，雨天也照旧去田里除草。

en: Her hard labor was itself a kind of refusal to take in a husband by adoption.
u.src: 她卖力气的工作，就是对招赘丈夫的某种拒绝。

en: In the end, Aju had no choice but to give up the idea of finding an adopted husband for her daughter-in-law Amin.
u.src: 最后阿住不得不放弃替儿媳妇阿民招赘丈夫的想法。

en: Still, giving up that idea was not necessarily an unpleasant thing for Aju.
u.src: 不过，放弃这个想法，对阿住来说，不一定是一件不愉快的事儿。

en: Amin supported the livelihood of the whole family with the strength of one woman.
u.src: 阿民以一个女人的力量支撑全家的生计。

en: Without doubt, this must have come from her resolve to do it for her son Ahiro.
u.src: 无疑，这肯定是来自“为了儿子阿广”的这个决心。

en: But it may also have been the power of the bloodline rooted deep within her, the daughter of outsiders who had moved to this generation from a remote place.
u.src: 但是，也可能是因为阿广是从偏僻的为地方迁居到这一代的“外地人”的女儿，那种根植在她内心深处的基因的力量。

en: Azumi had heard this many times from the old woman next door:
u.src: 阿住多次从邻居阿婆那里听说——

en: The strength of your Amin really does not match her appearance; the other day I saw her walk past me carrying four big bundles of rice stalks.
u.src: “你们家阿民的力量真的跟她的外表很不相称啊，上次看到她扛着四大把的稻子从我面前走过去。”

en: To show her gratitude to Amin, Azhu took on all the household chores,
u.src: 阿住为了表达自己对阿民的感谢，包办了家里的有家务，

en: such as looking after her grandson Guangci, tending the cow, cooking, doing laundry, and going to the neighbors to fetch water.
u.src: 诸如照顾孙子广次、养牛、煮饭、洗衣、去邻居家提水等等。

en: Come to think of it, there really was no small amount of housework to do at home.
u.src: ——说起来家里的家务活儿也真不少呢。

en: But Azhu found joy in it, bending over as she busied herself with the work.
u.src: 但是，阿住乐在其中，弯腰忙碌着。

en: It was a night in late autumn.
u.src: 深秋，某个夜晚。

en: Amin went home alone, carrying a large bundle of pine needles.
u.src: 阿民独自抱着一大捆松叶回家。

en: Azumi was carrying Hirotsugu on her back while boiling water in the cramped earthen-floored kitchen to get the bath ready.
u.src: 阿住正背着广次，正在狭小的土间烧水准备洗澡。

en: It is cold outside, isn't it?
u.src: “外面很冷吧？

en: Why did you come back so late today?
u.src: 今天怎么回来这么晚啊？”

en: I did a little more today than usual.
u.src: “今天比以往做的事情多了些。”

en: Amin set a large bundle of pine needles beside the water trough and, too lazy to take off her mud-covered straw sandals, went straight over to the big stove.
u.src: 阿民将一大捆松叶放在水槽旁边，懒得脱下满是泥巴的草鞋，径直走到大灶旁边。

en: Beneath the big stove, an oak branch was burning, its deep red flames flickering.
u.src: 大灶下面正燃烧着一根栎树枝，赤红的火焰晃动着。

en: Azumi tried to stand up, but with Hirotsugu on her back, she could not get to her feet at all unless she held onto the rim of the bath tub.
u.src: 阿住想要站起来，但是背着广次的她，倘若不抓住洗澡桶的边缘，根本没办法站起来。

en: You go take a bath first!
u.src: “你先去洗澡吧！”

en: I will take a bath later; right now I am even hungrier.
u.src: “等会儿再洗澡，我现在肚子更饿。

en: Give me a sweet potato or something to eat first!
u.src: 先给我吃个地瓜什么的吧！
——饭煮好了吗？
婆婆！”

en: Asumi staggered over to the sink and took the whole pot of sweet potatoes and greens from the large stove.
u.src: 阿住步履蹒跚的走到水槽旁，从大灶里取出整锅地瓜煮青菜。

en: It was cooked long ago, and I have been waiting for you. Look, it is almost cold.
u.src: “很早就煮好了呢，一直在等你，你看，都快凉了。”

en: The two of them skewered the sweet potatoes on bamboo sticks, then roasted them a little over the stove fire.
u.src: 两个人将地瓜用竹签串起来，又放在灶火上烤一烤。

en: Ah Guang is sound asleep, so lay him down and let him sleep!
u.src: “阿广睡得挺熟的，把他放下来睡吧！”

en: Oh dear! It really is too cold today,
u.src: “哎呀！今天真的太冷了，

en: put him down; I am afraid he will not sleep well.
u.src: 放他下来，怕他睡不好。”

en: By then, Amin had already begun wolfing down a steaming sweet potato.
u.src: 这个时候，阿民已经开始狼吐虎咽的吃着冒着热气的地瓜了。

en: It was the way of eating that only farmers worn out to exhaustion could understand, and Amin took a huge bite from the side where the bamboo skewer had been pulled out.
u.src: 那是一种累的精疲力竭的农民才明白的吃法，阿民从抽出竹签的一侧，大口吃下去。

en: Aju, meanwhile, stood beside him with heavy, sound asleep Hiroji on his back, constantly placing more sweet potatoes on the stove fire to roast.
u.src: 阿住则在一旁背着沉甸甸、酣睡着的广次，并不停的把地瓜放到灶火上烤。

en: In any case, working alone the way you do must make you get hungry more easily than other people!
u.src: “无论如何，如你这样独自工作，肯定是比别人更容易饿啊！”

en: Asumi looked at her daughter-in-law and spoke with deep emotion.
u.src: 阿住看着儿媳妇，感慨的说道。

en: But Amin did not say a word and only kept wolfing down the roasted sweet potato that had turned black.
u.src: 但是，阿民一句话也没说，只顾着狼吞虎咽的吃着烤的发黑的地瓜。

en: Amin threw herself more and more desperately into her work, taking on by herself all the work that the men should have done.
u.src: 阿民对工作越来越拼命，她一个人承担着所有男人应该做的工作。

en: At times, she would even carry a lamp at night and make rounds through the vegetable garden.
u.src: 时而，夜晚还提着灯在菜园里巡查。

en: Aju felt her heart filled with admiration for this daughter-in-law, a woman who yielded nothing to any man.
u.src: 阿住对这个巾帼不让须眉的儿媳妇，心里充满着敬佩之情。

en: No, rather than admiration, it would be more accurate to call it awe.
u.src: 不，与其说是敬佩，毋宁说是敬畏更为准确。

en: Amin left all the other work to Aju, apart from the work in the fields and the mountains.
u.src: 阿民把除了田地、山里的工作之外，其他工作都交由阿住负责。

en: Lately, Amin had even begun washing her own underclothes only rarely.
u.src: 最近一段时间，阿民连自己的贴身衣物也很少洗了。

en: Even so, Aju never uttered the slightest complaint, but forced her already bent back upright and kept working with all her might.
u.src: 就算是这样，阿住也没有丝毫怨言，硬挺着已经佝偻的腰背，拼命一直做。

en: Not only that, whenever she met the old woman next door, she would always praise her daughter-in-law with a grave and earnest expression:
u.src: 不仅仅是这样，只要碰见邻居阿婆，也总会严肃认真的夸奖自己的儿媳妇：

en: “At any rate, with Amin working so hard, even if I die, there will be no need to worry about the household anymore.”
u.src: “无论如何，像阿民这么的勤奋工作，即使我死了，也无须担心家里的事情了。”

en: However, Amin's desperate money-making sickness seemed never to be satisfied.
u.src: 不过，阿民这种拼命的“挣钱病”似乎完全没有满足的时候。

en: Another year passed, and Amin proposed expanding the mulberry fields to the far side of the river.
u.src: 又过了一年，阿民提出将桑田扩展到河对岸的打算。

en: According to Amin himself, nearly a mu of land brought in only ten yuan in rent, which was hardly worth it.
u.src: 据阿民自己说，将近一亩多的土地只能收到十圆的地租，十分不划算。

en: It would be better to take that plot back, plant mulberry trees on it himself, and raise silkworms during the slack farming season,
u.src: 不如将那块地拿回来自己种植桑树，农闲的时候养蚕，

en: and as long as cocoon prices did not fluctuate greatly, it could bring in at least one hundred and fifty yuan a year.
u.src: 只要蚕茧的行情没有大的变动，一年至少能有一百五十圆的收入。

en: But although they needed money no matter what, Azhu simply could not bear the thought of working even harder just to earn more.
u.src: 但是无论如何需要钱，只要想到要为了赚钱更加辛苦操劳，阿住实在难以接受。

en: Especially with something as time-consuming and laborious as raising silkworms, the two of them could never easily agree whenever they discussed it.
u.src: 尤其是养蚕这种费时费力的事情，两个人每次商量都很难达成共识。

en: At last Azhu could not hold back and protested to Amin in a complaining tone:
u.src: 阿住最后忍不住用抱怨的语气，抗议阿民：
“这件事还是算了吧，阿民！

ja: れたいわけではないの。
en: It is not that I want to shirk the work.
u.src: 我不是想要推脱工作。

en: But if I do not turn it down, there is not a single man in the house, and there is also a clingy child,
u.src: 但是如果不推脱的话，家里一个男人也没有，还有一个黏人的孩子，

en: and things as they are already leave me unable to catch my breath.
u.src: 现况我已经令我难以喘息了。

ja: それなのにあなたはまだ
どうしてそんなことが
en: And you still want to raise silkworms; how could that possibly be done?
u.src: 你竟然还想养蚕，怎么可能做到呢？

en: Please think about my situation too!"
u.src: 你也顾虑下我的情况啊！”

en: After listening to her mother-in-law's tearful complaint, Amin thought that if she kept insisting, she really would be unreasonable.
u.src: 阿民听完婆婆的哭诉，心里想如果自己继续坚持的话，也委实不够通情达理。

en: Although she gave up the idea of raising silkworms, she still insisted on planting mulberry fields.
u.src: 尽管放弃了养蚕的想法，却依然要坚持种植桑田。

en: Amin looked at Azhu with resentment and said in a sarcastic tone, "Fine then!
u.src: 阿民心有不服的看着阿住，以讽刺的语气说：“那好吧！

en: After all, when it comes to planting the mulberry fields, I can do it all by myself."
u.src: 反正种植桑田的事情，只需要我一个人就行了。”

en: After this happened, Azhu began thinking again about finding a live-in son-in-law.
u.src: 这件事发生之后，阿住又想惦记起招赘女婿的事情了。

en: Before, she had wanted to arrange a husband for Amin because she worried about their livelihood and about the neighbors' gossip.
u.src: 之前是担心生计问题，也担心邻居们的闲言碎语，才想要替阿民招赘丈夫。
但是如今不一样了，

en: Even if it was only to escape a temporary spell of labor, she therefore started thinking about finding a husband for Amin.
u.src: 即便是为了逃开一时的劳务，因此她就惦记为阿民招赘丈夫这件事了。

en: So compared with before, his attitude this time toward finding a husband for Amin became even more determined.
u.src: 所以比起之前，这次他想为阿民招赘丈夫的态度就更加坚决了。

en: It was the season when the orange trees behind the house were in bloom. One evening, Osumi sat under the oil lamp, working as she once again brought up the matter of taking in a husband for the family.
u.src: 正是屋后面橘子园花开的时节，一天晚上，阿住坐在油灯下，一边干活，一边又有条不絮的说起招赘的事情。

ja: のそばにあぐらをかき、
った。「あなたはどうして、また
en: Otami sat cross-legged beside the hearth, biting on salted peas, and said in dissent, "Why do you have to bring up taking in a husband again?
u.src: 阿民在炉子旁边盘坐，嘴里咬着咸豌豆，不敢苟同的说：“您为什么要又要提起招赘的事情呢？

en: I do not want to hear a word of it."
u.src: 我一点也不想听啦。”

ja: けることはなかっただろう。
en: If this had been the old Osumi, hearing Otami answer with such resistance would probably have made her give up then and there and stop talking about it.
u.src: 倘若是以前的阿住，听阿民这么抗拒的回答，大概就会就此作罢，不再继续说下去了。

ja: った。「そんなにきっぱり
en: But this time, contrary to her usual way, Osumi refused to let the matter drop and went on, "You should not speak so absolutely!
u.src: 但是这次却一反往常，阿住不肯结束的继续说道：“话也不能说的这么决绝啊！

ja: たっているし、こんなときは、やはり
いたほうがいいでしょう……」
en: For the funeral at Miyashita's tomorrow, it happens to be our household's turn to dig the grave, and at a time like that it is best to have a man around..."
u.src: 明天宫下的葬礼，正好轮到咱们家负责挖墓穴，这种时候，最好要有一个男人在嘛……”

en: All right! Leave digging the grave to me.
u.src: “行啦！挖墓穴的事情交给我就行了。”

en: How could that possibly be okay? After all, you're a woman...
u.src: “那怎么行啊，你毕竟是个女人……”

en: Aju had meant to give a few deliberately forced laughs.
u.src: 本来阿住想故意干笑几下。

ja: えなければならないと
en: But when she saw the expression on Amin's face, she suddenly felt that even an unintentional smile would have to be restrained.
u.src: 但是她在看到阿民脸上的神情的时候，突然觉得即使是不经意的笑，也要有所收敛。

ja: つもりだったのですか
en: Grandma, are you really planning to stay at home doing nothing and live an easy life?
u.src: “婆婆，难道你想在家里什么都不做，想享清福了吗？”

en: Amin sat cross-legged, hugging her knees, and sneered coldly.
u.src: 阿民盘膝而坐，抱着膝盖，冷冷的嘲讽。

en: Azhu, whose thoughts had suddenly been exposed, could not help taking off her glasses.
u.src: 猛然被戳破心中所想的阿住，忍不住摘下自己的眼镜。

en: As for why she had taken off her glasses, she did not understand it herself.
u.src: 至于摘下眼镜的原因，她自己也不明白。

en: How could you say such a thing?
u.src: 你怎么会说出这种话？”

en: Have you forgotten what you said with your own mouth before A-Guang's father died?
u.src: “阿广的父亲去世之前，你亲口说的话，你忘了吗？

en: You said that if the family's fields were divided in two, you would be failing your ancestors...
u.src: 你说倘若家里的田地被分成两份，你就对不起祖先……”
“的确！

en: I did indeed say those words.
u.src: 我的确说过这些话。
但是，认真想想。

en: As the saying goes, one time is one thing, another time is another,
u.src: 俗话说‘此一时，彼一时’，

en: so this is something that cannot be helped either.
u.src: 这也是没办法的事儿。”

en: Although Ozumi desperately explained all sorts of reasons why she needed a man, even she herself found those words hard to believe.
u.src: 虽然阿住拼命解释需要一个男人的各种理由，但是这些话连她自己都难以信服。

en: What mattered most was what she truly thought deep down:
u.src: 最主要的是她内心的真实想法——

en: she had not fully revealed her real wish to live an easy, idle life.
u.src: 她希望自己可以过得清闲日子的真实意图并未和盘托出。

en: Otami saw straight through what the old woman was thinking, and still chewing salted peas, she accused her without the slightest courtesy.
u.src: 阿民一眼就看穿了婆婆心里的想法，依旧咬着咸豌豆，一点都不客气的指责婆婆。

en: Because of this, Ozumi finally understood that Otami was in fact a sharp-tongued person.
u.src: 因为这样，阿住才明白，原来阿民是一个言辞犀利的人呢。

en: If you did that, it might be better for you, Mother-in-law.
u.src: “那样做的话，可能对婆婆比较有好处。

en: After all, you will die first.
u.src: 毕竟你会先死。
——但是，婆婆啊！

en: You have to think about me a little too.
u.src: 你也得为我考虑考虑。

en: I am not willing to remain a widow because I am full of myself and look down on other people.
u.src: 我不是因为自以为是，看不起别人，所以才会甘愿守寡。

ja: ることもできないほどに
en: Sometimes, when I am so exhausted that I cannot sleep,
u.src: 有时候，累的精疲力竭难以入眠，

en: I also wonder why I insist on holding on so stubbornly.
u.src: 我也会想自己为什么要这么固执的坚守呢？

en: But when I think about it again, all of this is something I have no choice about.
u.src: 但是又一想，这一切也都是无奈之举。

en: I do all this for our family, for A-Guang,
u.src: 这么做都是为了咱们这个家，为了阿广，

ja: くだけしかないのです……」
en: and in the end all I can do is cry a little...”
u.src: 最后只能哭一哭罢了……”

en: After listening to Amin say this, Azhu could only stare blankly at her daughter-in-law.
u.src: 听完阿民的这番话，阿住只能茫然的看着儿媳妇。

en: She had already gradually come to recognize one fact.
u.src: 她已经逐渐认清了一个事实。

ja: れないということだった。
en: It was that no matter how she struggled, she would never be able to live an easy life until the day she died.
u.src: 那就是不管她如何挣扎，不到她死的那天，她根本没办法过上轻松的日子。

en: Azhu put her glasses back on again.
u.src: 阿住重新又戴上了眼镜。

en: Then, as if speaking to herself, she summed up the conversation.
u.src: 接着，似是自言自语般为此次谈话做了一个总结。

ja: だけではやはりだめなのだ、
en: But, Amin, you still cannot live in this world on grand principles alone,
u.src: “但是，阿民，这俗世生活只靠大道理还是不行的，
你再想想吧。

en: I will never bring this matter up again.
u.src: 这事儿我以后都不会再提了。”

en: About twenty minutes later, a young man from the village passed by the front of the house, humming a song.
u.src: 约莫过了二十分钟，村里的一个年轻人，一边哼着歌一边从家门口路过。

en: Young auntie, are you going to cut grass today?
u.src: “年轻的阿婶，今天去割草吗？

en: The grass is swaying in the wind!
u.src: 草儿随风摇摆呦！

en: Take up the sickle and go cut the grass!
u.src: 拿起镰刀去割草呦！”

en: As the singing gradually faded into the distance, Aju, wearing her glasses, looked at Amin once more.
u.src: ——歌声渐渐远去，阿住戴着眼镜，又看了阿民一眼。

ja: ばして、しきりにあくびをしていた。
en: Amin merely sat facing the oil lamp, stretching out his legs and yawning again and again.
u.src: 阿民只是对着油灯，伸长了腿，不停的打哈欠。

en: Oh dear, go to bed early; you still have to get up early tomorrow.
u.src: “啊呀，早点睡觉吧，明天还要早起。”

en: After Amin finished saying this, he grabbed a handful of salted peas and struggled up from beside the stove...
u.src: 阿民说完这句话，抓了一把咸豌豆，费力从炉边站起来……

en: For the next three or four years, Amin bore all the hardship by herself.
u.src: 在这之后的三四年间，阿民独自一人承担着所有的劳苦。

en: That suffering was like an old, failing horse being made to pull in the same rut as a young, strong, unruly horse.
u.src: 那种痛苦就像一匹垂老的马匹，和一匹年轻体健的悍马同负一辄。

en: Amin still went out every day and kept doing the fieldwork without sparing herself any toil.
u.src: 阿民依旧天天外出，不辞辛苦的做着田里的工作。

en: Azumi also managed the household just as she had before.
u.src: 阿住也和以前一样操持家务。

en: But there was always an invisible whip threatening to strike Azumi.
u.src: 但是，总有一根看不见的鞭子在威胁着要抽打阿住。

en: Sometimes it was because she had not heated the bathwater, sometimes because she had forgotten to dry the rice, and sometimes because the cow had slipped away.
u.src: 有时候因为没烧洗澡水，有时候因为忘记晒稻子，有时候因为牛偷偷跑掉了，

en: For one negligence or another, Azumi would always be scolded by Amin.
u.src: 阿住总会因为这样或那样的疏忽被阿民数落一顿。

en: Even so, she never talked back, but silently endured the pain.
u.src: 不过她从来不还嘴，只是默默忍受着苦痛。

en: There were two reasons for this.
u.src: 这是因为两个原因：

en: First, she had grown used to obedience.
u.src: 一是，她习惯了顺从；

en: Second, compared with Amin, her grandson Hiroji was closer to her.
u.src: 二是，和阿民相比，孙子广次对自己更加亲近。

en: In fact, in other people's eyes, Osumi had hardly changed at all from before.
u.src: 事实上，在旁人的眼里，阿住和以前几乎毫无变化。

en: If one really had to point out a change, it was that she no longer praised her daughter-in-law Otami as she used to.
u.src: 倘若真要说出一点变化的话，那就是她不再像以前一样夸赞自己的儿媳妇阿民。

en: However, this slight change did not draw anyone else's attention.
u.src: 不过，这种细微的变化，并未引起旁人的注意。

en: At least the old woman next door still thought of Osumi as someone who was storing up virtue for the next life.
u.src: 至少邻居家的阿婆和以往一样认为阿住是一个“来世积德”的人。

en: On a summer day, at a certain bright, sunlit noon, Azumi and the old woman from next door were chatting under the grape-leaf trellis in front of the storehouse.
u.src: 夏日，某个艳阳高照的正午，阿住和邻居家的阿婆正在仓库前面爬满葡萄叶的棚架下聊天。

en: Except for the buzzing of flies in the cowshed, everything around them was unusually quiet.
u.src: 除了牛棚里苍蝇的嗡嗡声，周围格外安静。

en: As the old woman from next door chatted, she smoked a short cigarette, a butt her son had not finished and that she had carefully saved.
u.src: 邻居家阿婆一边聊天，一边吸着短烟卷——那是她儿子没吸完的烟蒂，她仔细收集的。
“阿民呢？

en: Oh, I suppose she has gone to cut grass again, has she?
u.src: 喔，应该又去割草了吧？

en: She may be young, but she is willing to do just about anything.
u.src: 别看她年纪轻轻的，但却什么都愿意做呢。”
“哪里呀！

en: For women, it is better to stay home and do housework than to go out and work in the fields.
u.src: 女人与其外出去田里工作，倒不如在家做做家务更好呢。”
“不是的！

en: Being able to go out and help in the fields is better than anything.
u.src: 能够外出在田里帮忙比什么都强。

ja: りなどもしたことがありません
en: Take my daughter-in-law, for example. She has been married into our family for seven years, and she has never done fieldwork, not even weeding or anything like that.
u.src: 像我家儿媳妇，嫁进门七年了，别说是田里的工作，就连除草之类的也没做过。

en: Every day she just hides away at home, washing the children's clothes, mending her own clothes, and letting the days pass.
u.src: 天天就躲在家里，给孩子洗衣服，缝补自己的衣服，混日子。”

en: That is just the right way to do it.
u.src: “那样子才好呢。

en: Take good care of the child and make yourself look pretty,
u.src: 把孩子照顾好，把自己打扮漂亮，

en: and then you will look all the more respectable.
u.src: 看着才更加体面啊。”

en: But speaking of that, young people these days do not like going out to work in the fields--huh? Listen, what is that sound?
u.src: “不过说起来，现在的年轻人都不喜欢外出去田里工作——咦？你听是什么声音？”
“什么声音啊？

en: You are making way too much of it; it is just the sound of a cow farting, is it not?
u.src: 你也太大惊小怪了，不就是牛放屁的声音吗？”

en: Was that the sound of a cow farting?
u.src: “是牛放屁的声音吗？

en: Honestly, though, come to think of it,
u.src: 真是的——不过说起来，

en: Amin is still so young, yet she goes out into the fields to weed under the blazing sun,
u.src: 阿民如此年轻，愿意顶着炎炎烈日，外出到田里除草，

en: when you think about it, that really is hard work.
u.src: 说起来也真是辛苦。”

en: The two old women chatted idly like this, asking and answering each other.
u.src: 两个老婆婆就这样一问一答的闲聊着。

en: For more than eight years after Nitaro died, the livelihood of the whole family, young and old, had been supported by Amin alone.
u.src: 仁太郎死了之后的这八年多，全家老小的生计都靠着阿民一个女人独自支撑。

en: At the same time, Amin had unknowingly built a good image, and her reputation spread so far that even people outside the village knew of her.
u.src: 与此同时，阿民在不知不觉中形成了好形象，声名远播，就连村子外的人都知道。

ja: おばさん」でもなかった。
en: Amin was no longer merely a young widow who worked day and night to earn money, much less the young auntie spoken of by the young men in the village.
u.src: 阿民不仅仅只是一个日夜操劳“赚钱”的年轻寡妇了，更不是村子里年轻男人口里的“年轻阿婶”。

en: Now she was a model daughter-in-law and also a model of chastity for the present age.
u.src: 现在，她是模范媳妇，也是当今贞女的模范。

en: Look at Amin over on the other side of the river, people would say, and that line had almost become a stock phrase for scolding others.
u.src: ——“瞅瞅人家河对岸的阿民。”——这句话几乎成了很多人斥责别人的口头禅。

en: But Osumi did not tell the old woman next door about the suffering in her heart, nor did she intend to tell anyone of her grievances.
u.src: 但是，阿住没有把自己心里的苦衷告诉邻居家的阿婆，也不打算把自己的委屈告诉任何人。

en: Though she herself did not really understand it, she still firmly believed that somewhere unseen there was a heavenly justice.
u.src: 虽然她自己心里并不明白，却仍坚信冥冥之中自有天理。

en: But in the end even that small bit of salvation came to nothing.
u.src: 但是最后连这一点救赎也泡汤了。

en: Now the only support she had left was her grandson Hiroji, and there was nothing else at all.
u.src: 现在，她唯一的依靠只剩下孙子广次了，其他什么都没了。

en: Unexpectedly, even this last and only support was now on the verge of being lost.
u.src: 不过意想不到的是，就连这最后唯一的依靠，也要濒临失去的风险了。

en: On a crisp autumn afternoon, his grandson Hirotsugu clutched his schoolbag and hurried home from school.
u.src: 一个秋高气爽的午后，孙子广次抱着书包，慌忙从学校跑回家里。

en: At that moment, Osumi was deftly handling a kitchen knife in front of the storehouse, getting ready to hang Hachiya persimmons to dry.
u.src: 阿住当时正在仓库前利索的挥动菜刀，准备接着把蜂屋柿子吊起来晒干。

en: Hirotsugu nimbly jumped over a mat where rice was drying, stood at attention, and bowed to his grandmother Osumi.
u.src: 广次动作灵敏的跳过一张晒着稻谷的席子，立正站好，向祖母阿住行礼。

en: Then he asked her directly, with a serious look: "Grandma, is my mother really such an extraordinary person?"
u.src: 接着严肃的直接问道：“奶奶，我妈妈真的是一个非常了不起的人吗？”

ja: どうしてそんなふうに
u.src: “怎么会这么问呢？”

en: Unable to help herself, Azhu stopped cutting with the kitchen knife in her hand and stared intently at her grandson.
u.src: 阿住忍不住停下手里的菜刀，凝视着孙子。

en: Because this is what the teacher said in moral education class!
u.src: “因为这是老师在修身课上说的话啊！

en: The teacher said with his own mouth that there was not another person as admirable as Koji's mother for a hundred miles around.
u.src: 老师亲口说像广次的母亲如此了不起的人，方圆百里也没有第二个了。”

en: Did the teacher say that himself?
u.src: “老师亲口说的？”

en: Yes, of course the teacher said so.
u.src: “嗯，当然是老师说的。
这是真的吗？”

en: The first thing Osumi felt was embarrassment.
u.src: 阿住最先的感受是困窘。

en: A schoolteacher had actually told such a huge lie to his own grandson, Hirotsugu—
u.src: 学校的老师居然对自己的孙子广次说了这么大一个谎言——

en: In fact, Osumi felt that nothing could be more astonishing than this.
u.src: 事实上，阿住觉得再也没有比这件事更令人诧异的事了。

en: But after a moment of embarrassment, Osumi suddenly flew into a rage,
u.src: 可是，在一瞬的困窘之后，阿住突然大发脾气，

en: and began scolding Otami as if she had become a different person.
u.src: 像是变成另一个人一样骂起了阿民。

en: It is a lie, without a doubt a huge lie!
u.src: 是谎言，毫无置疑是大谎言！

en: Your mother only cares about working herself to death outside, making everyone think she is a remarkable person, but in truth she has the worst heart of all.
u.src: 你母亲只顾着在外面拼命工作，让大家觉得她是个了不起的人，实际上她心里最坏了。

en: Grandmother is being bullied and pushed around by her; she is stubborn and headstrong...
u.src: 奶奶被她欺负的团团转，她固执又好强……”

en: Hirotsugu stared in astonishment at his grandmother Osumi, who had suddenly flown into a rage.
u.src: 广次诧异的看着突然大发脾气的祖母阿住。

en: Then Osumi suddenly drew back the anger she had just been showing and began to shed sorrowful tears.
u.src: 这时，阿住又突然收敛之前的脾气，改为悲伤的掉眼泪。

en: So you see, Grandma can go on living only because she has you to hope for.
u.src: “因此啊，奶奶都是因为有你这个指望才能活得下去。
你千万别忘了。

en: You will soon be seventeen, and by then you must hurry and bring a wife into the house so Grandma can finally enjoy some ease.
u.src: 你很快就十七岁了，到那时候一定要早点娶媳妇进门，奶奶才可以享享清福。

ja: をもらえばいいなどと
en: Your mother says you should wait until you come back from being a soldier before marrying, but that is easy enough for her to say.
u.src: 你母亲还说什么要等到你当兵回来之后再娶亲，说的到轻松简单。

ja: たなければならないんだい！
en: Why, why should you have to wait until after you become a soldier!
u.src: 为什么，为什么要等当兵之后！

en: Do you understand what I am saying?
u.src: 你听明白了吗？

en: You must be good to Grandma, and you must be good to her for your father's share too!
u.src: 你要孝顺奶奶，连你父亲的那份一起孝顺奶奶喔！

en: Then Grandma will love you dearly too, and she will leave everything to you.
u.src: 这样，奶奶也会很疼爱你，什么都留给你。”

en: If the persimmons ripen, will you let me have some too?
u.src: “如果柿子成熟了，你也会给我吃吗？”

en: Gluttonous Hirotsugu said as he toyed with the persimmons in the basket.
u.src: 嘴馋的广次把玩着篮子里的柿子说道。

en: Of course I will let you eat it!
u.src: “当然给你吃啊！

en: Even though you are still young now, you ought to understand this.
u.src: 虽然你现在年龄还小，但是你应该明白才是。
永远不要忘记喔！”

en: Azhu suddenly stopped crying and burst into a smile...
u.src: 阿住突然破涕为笑了……

en: The next day after that incident, Azumi finally got into a fierce quarrel with Atami over a trivial matter.
u.src: 这件事之后的第二天，阿住终究因为一件小事，和阿民发生了激烈争执。

en: The trivial matter in question was only that Azumi had eaten Atami's sweet potato.
u.src: 这里所说的小事，只是阿住吃了阿民的地瓜罢了。

en: Unexpectedly, the quarrel grew fiercer and fiercer, and Atami laughed coldly in mockery and said, "If you hate working, then go die!"
u.src: 没想到越吵越凶，阿民嘲讽的冷笑，说道：“你不喜欢做事，那就去死啊！”

en: When Azumi heard those words, she was unlike her usual self and screamed wildly with her whole body.
u.src: 阿住听到这句话，跟以往不同，整个人疯狂的吼叫。

en: Just then, her grandson Hirotsugu was sleeping soundly with his head on his grandmother Azumi's lap.
u.src: 这时候，孙子广次刚好枕在祖母阿住的膝盖上酣睡。
“阿广，醒醒！醒醒！”

en: As Azumi shook her grandson Hirotsugu, she kept cursing Atami: "Ahiro, wake up!
u.src: 阿住一边摇晃孙子广次，一边不停的骂阿民：“阿广，醒醒！
阿广，醒醒！醒醒！

en: Get up and listen to the vile thing your mother said.
u.src: 起来听听你母亲说的什么混账话。

en: Your mother told me to go die!
u.src: 你母亲让我去死啊！

en: You had better listen carefully and understand.
u.src: 你可要认真听清楚。

en: Even though your mother has earned a little money.
u.src: 尽管你母亲赚了一点钱。

en: But those few mu of fields were all cleared and cultivated by your grandfather and grandmother!
u.src: 但是那几亩田地都是爷爷奶奶开垦出来的呀！

en: But what difference does that make?
u.src: 但是那又如何呢？

en: Your mother actually told me to die.
u.src: 你母亲竟然让我去死。

en: Atami will die sooner or later too.
u.src: 阿民，早晚会死。

en: There is nothing frightening about death!
u.src: 死没什么可怕的！

en: No, I will not fall for your scheme.
u.src: 不，我才不中你的计。

en: I will die, I will die sooner or later.
u.src: 我会死，我早晚会死。

en: But even if I die, I will never forgive you..."
u.src: 但我就算死也饶不过你……”

en: Azhu shouted abuse at the top of her voice and huddled together with her grandson, who was so frightened that he burst into tears.
u.src: 阿住高声叫骂，和吓得哭出声的孙子抱成一团。

en: But Amin, utterly unconcerned, went on lying beside the hearth and pretended not to hear.
u.src: 但是，阿民毫不在意的依旧躺在炉子旁边，假装没听见。
但是，阿住并没有死。

en: Instead, before the Beginning of Spring the following year, Amin, who had always considered himself strong and healthy, came down with typhoid; on the eighth day after falling ill, he breathed his last and died.
u.src: 反倒是来年立春之前，一向自以为身强体健的阿民得了伤寒，发病第八天就呜呼哀哉，死掉了。

en: In fact, by that time, who knew how many people in the village had already come down with the cold.
u.src: 实际上，那时候村里已经有不知道多少人患上了风寒。

en: Moreover, before Amin fell ill, he had helped dig the grave for the funeral of the blacksmith who had died of typhoid.
u.src: 而且，阿民在发病之前，曾经帮忙为因伤寒去世的铁匠的葬礼，挖掘墓穴。

en: The blacksmith had a young apprentice who had also caught the cold at the time, and he was only sent to the hospital on the day of the funeral.
u.src: 铁匠有个小徒弟当时也染上了风寒，葬礼当天才被送到医院。

en: "He must have caught the cold then."
u.src: “应该就是那个时候被传染上风寒的。”

en: After the doctor left, Azhu mildly scolded Amin, whose face was flushed red from the high fever.
u.src: ——阿住在医生走了之后，对因为高烧而满脸通红的阿民稍加训斥。

en: On the day of Amin's funeral procession, even though it was raining, every villager, including the village head, came to attend the funeral without a single person missing.
u.src: 阿民出殡那天，尽管天下着雨，但是包括村主任在内的所有村民，一个不少全都来参加葬礼。

en: Everyone at the funeral sighed deeply for Amin, and they also felt profound sympathy for Aju and Hirotsugu, who had lost the main worker in their household.
u.src: 葬礼上的人，没有人不为阿民扼腕长叹，也对失去了家庭主要劳动力的阿住和广次深表同情。

en: The villagers' representative also mentioned that the county office had recently been planning to commend the hardworking Amin.
u.src: 村民代表还说起，本来最近郡公所计划赞扬勤奋的阿民。

en: After hearing these words, Aju had nothing else to say except to offer thanks.
u.src: 阿住听了这些话，除了致谢也没有其他话可说。
“唉，这都是命啊！

en: Since last year, we had applied to the county office about giving Amin a commendation, and the village head and I spent quite a lot of money on train fares,
u.src: 去年开始，我们就对赞扬阿民的事情，向郡公所提出了申请，村主任和我花了不少火车票钱，

en: we went back and forth to meet the county office chief five times, and truly went to great pains over it!
u.src: 前前后后见了郡公所长五次，真是煞费苦心啊 ！

en: Now that things have come to this, we can only give up, and you can only give up too.
u.src: 事已至此，我们也只能死心了，你们也只能死心了。”

en: The villagers' representative, a slightly balding good-natured man, added this joking remark at the end,
u.src: ——村民代表头有些秃，是个老好人，最后他补上这么一句玩笑话，

en: which made the young elementary school teacher glare at him with great displeasure.
u.src: 让年轻的小学老师非常不满的瞪着他看。

en: On the night after the funeral was over, Azumi and Hiroji slept together inside the mosquito net in a corner of the back room where the Buddhist altar stood.
u.src: 办完丧事的当天晚上，阿住和广次一起睡在设有佛坛的里屋一角的蚊帐内。

en: Until then, whenever the two of them went to sleep at night, the room had always been pitch-dark,
u.src: 以往两人夜晚睡觉的时候屋里都是漆黑的，

ja: じったせいだったのだろう
en: but tonight a lamp was lit on the altar, and perhaps it was because of the strange smell made by disinfectant mingling with the odor of old tatami.
u.src: 今晚佛坛上点着灯，再加上消毒水的味道混合陈旧的榻榻米所形成的奇怪气味，可能就是这个原因吧！

en: Azumi lay on the tatami, tossing from side to side, unable to fall asleep.
u.src: 阿住躺在榻榻米上辗转发侧，难以入眠。

en: Atami's death had indeed brought her an immense feeling of happiness.
u.src: 阿民的死确实给她带来了巨大的幸福感。

en: From now on, she would no longer have to toil as she had before, nor would she have to worry about the villagers' gossip.
u.src: 从现在开始，她再也不用像从前那样操劳了，也不用担心村民的闲言碎语。

en: The household had about three thousand yen in savings, as well as several mu of farmland.
u.src: 家里约莫有三千圆的存款，还有几亩田地。

en: After this, she could eat white rice with her grandson and, whenever she liked, take a straw bag and go buy the salted trout she loved.
u.src: 从此之后，她就可以和孙子一起吃大米饭，随时带着草袋去买自己喜欢吃的咸鳟鱼。

en: Azumi simply could not remember any time in her life when she had ever felt as light and free as she did now.
u.src: 阿住实在记不起来自己的一生之中，有什么时候曾像现在一般轻松自在过？
啊！

ja: だったことがあったか
en: Had she ever felt as light and free as she did now?
u.src: 像现在一般轻松自在过？

en: A memory of a certain night nine years earlier suddenly appeared clearly in her mind.
u.src: ——九年前某一夜的记忆突然就清晰的出现在她脑海里。

en: The sense of relief she had felt that night was much the same as tonight.
u.src: 那一晚如释重负的感觉，和今夜差不多。

en: It was the night after the funeral of her own son had ended.
u.src: 那是她的亲生儿子葬礼介绍的夜晚。
而今天晚上呢？

en: It was the night after the funeral of the daughter-in-law who had borne her only grandson.
u.src: ——是生了唯一孙子的儿媳妇的葬礼结束的夜晚。

en: Osumi could not help opening her eyes.
u.src: 阿住忍不住睁开双眼眼。

en: Her grandson lay right beside her, his face wearing an innocent sleeping expression as he slept soundly and sweetly.
u.src: 孙子就躺在她身侧，脸上是天真无邪的睡容，睡的正香甜。

en: As Osumi looked at her grandson's peacefully sleeping face, she gradually felt that she truly was a person with a bitter fate.
u.src: 阿住看着孙子酣睡的面容，渐渐感觉自己真是一个苦命人。

en: At the same time, she felt that her son Nitaro and her daughter-in-law Otami, both bound to her by an ill-fated tie, were also people with bitter fates.
u.src: 与此同时，她觉得跟她之间有恶缘的儿子仁太郎和儿媳妇阿民也都是苦命人。

en: This change in her state of mind made her completely forget all the debts, kindnesses, and resentments of the past nine years.
u.src: 这种心境的变化，使得她完全忘了这九年间的恩恩怨怨。

en: No, even the future happiness that had given her comfort disappeared.
u.src: 不，甚至连让她感到慰藉的未来幸福也消失了。

en: The three of them, mother and son, mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, were all people with bitter fates, and hers was the most tragic of all.
u.src: 他们母子、婆媳三个人都是苦命人，尤其是她命运最为悲惨。

en: Otami, how could you leave me?
u.src: “阿民，你怎么就离开我了呢？”

en: Osumi could not help murmuring the name of Otami, who had only just died, and suddenly hot tears fell from her eyes.
u.src: ——阿住不由的喃喃呼唤刚去世的阿民，突然留下了热泪……

en: The clock struck four, and Osumi, worn out with fatigue, drifted off into a doze.
u.src: 时钟响了四下，阿住在疲惫中迷迷糊糊睡着了。

en: But by then, the sky above the thatched hut was already beginning to grow light.
u.src: 不过，那会儿茅草屋上的天空已经快亮了。
